events.title: A Sheltered Grove
events.description: Firelight in the branches. Farmers wave the line beneath canvas awnings.

events.title: Wayhouse Signal
events.description: A patched lantern swings from a signal post beside a stocked wayhouse.

events.title: Refugee Column
events.description: Cold hands, warm hearts. They ride the running boards until the next light.

events.title: Lantern Menders
events.description: A family of glassworkers trades sealed oil and a newly silvered reflector.

events.title: The Frozen Ferry
events.description: Ferryfolk chain their flywheel to the train and ask passage across the black ice.

events.title: Chapel of Quiet Brass
events.description: No sermon remains, only careful hands and a pit beneath the rails.

events.title: Moth Orchard
events.description: Pale fruit hangs under netting while luminous moths crowd the headlamp.

events.title: The Ash Seed
events.description: A gardener presses one warm seed into Mara's palm and marks a siding east.
events.summary: Supplies +4, begins the Ash Garden trail

events.title: The Ash Garden
events.description: The marked siding blooms gold around a greenhouse built from carriage glass.

events.title: A Bell Under Earth
events.description: A child at a lonely crossing asks whether you can hear the bell below the rails.
events.summary: Lumen +4, begins the Buried Bell trail

events.title: The Bell Keeper
events.description: The bell rises on chains. Its keeper pays in bronze and patches the train in silence.

events.title: Scrapfield Rails
events.description: Old rolling stock lies gutted but not empty. The Workshop crew brings torches.

events.title: Silent Pylons
events.description: A dead grid still hums beneath rain. The Battery drinks before the breakers fail.

events.title: Broken Signal Yard
events.description: Tangled rails, tangled dispatchers. Something keeps changing the points.

events.title: Relay Cache
events.description: Copper-wound relays sit dry in a dispatch bunker with one surviving accumulator.

events.title: Blind Switchyard
events.description: The safe points must be thrown by hand while silhouettes move between parked cars.

events.title: The Last Lampwright
events.description: A workshop window opens just long enough to pour blue-white oil into your tanks.

events.title: Repeating Signal
events.description: Three green, one dark, two amber. Orrin copies the impossible sequence.
events.summary: Scrap +3, begins the Signal Vault trail

events.title: Signal Vault 3-1-2
events.description: The copied sequence opens a buried dispatch vault as watchers gather on the roof.
events.summary: Scrap +14, power +4; faster Focus and salvo recharge; danger 2

events.title: Hollow Cut
events.description: The rails vanish into a pale, chewing throat that drinks the edge of the beam.

events.title: Shrike Nest
events.description: Metal feathers cover the ballast. Somebody is watching. Everyone is watching.

events.title: Black Rain
events.description: Oily rain drums on the roofs while a derailed tender glints beside the track.

events.title: Crawler Bridge
events.description: The bridge is intact. The things pretending to be rivets are not.

events.title: False Dawn
events.description: A bright horizon pulls current from every wire before revealing rows of teeth.
